Research supervision for a doctoral or Ph. D. dissertation in the field of high-frequency communication circuit components, devices and system is offered. The scope of research includes but are not limited to small antennas, filters, radio-frequency integrated circuits (RFIC), analog and digital processing LSI or mixed-signal LSI for a wired, wireless and optical communication system, wireless sensor network, wireless power transmission system and so on.
